title: additional problems for integrable systems
exact_target: Analyze perturbed focusing solitons and Toda shocks, and seek a definition of integrability intrinsic to probability.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8100007 (AMR-080-0007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II, SIGMA 13 (2017), 016, Problem 7.
Primary full-text formulation and 2017 historical progress discussion.

status_qualification: The printed focusing equation has an untilde u in its cubic term; the consistent unknown is explicitly used here as an editorial correction. The truncated integrable-probability question is restored. Suitability assumptions on perturbations are left as a required part of the programme, and the two-slit target has its separate canonical record 8100008. The source's defocusing theorem assumes $\ell>7/2$, while it expects extension to $\ell>2$; its later focusing comparison uses $\ell>2$ as the proposed regime. A proved defocusing threshold is not a proved focusing threshold.
